decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several Bluetooth speakers across different price points. The Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_116) offered the best sound quality but had a concerning review regarding receiving used units instead of new ones. The Audio Pro (prod_bluetooth_speakers_158) was quite expensive and had multiple complaints about connectivity and power-on friction. The EWA A106 Pro (prod_bluetooth_speakers_192) was a great budget option, but the reviews mentioned an annoying low-battery warning system. Given that a large portion of the feed consisted of accessories (cases and cables) and several speakers had low overall ratings (Pyle, Creative, Quikcell), I did not find a product that perfectly balanced reliability, price, and feature set for my current needs. I have decided to postpone my purchase.
